correctness.rationale: For each of the two permutation blocks, strict rearrangement uniquely bounds the base permutation squared distance by n(n²-1)/3, and the diagonal-simplex index change contributes at most 4(n-1)+2. Simultaneous equality is attainable exactly with one common maximum label and one common minimum label and opposite permutations. Equal diagonal indices give a smaller bound. Strict convexity excludes nonvertex farthest points. The resulting unique-partner characterization proves the pair count. The exact integer checker independently enumerates all 6, 66, and 1200 true vertices for n=2,3,4 and all their pairs; it confirms 1,3,24 diametral pairs, all maximizers, and squared diameters 16,36,68; explicit witnesses n=2..100 and seeded sample n=5 corroborate, not prove, the infinite statement.

value.rationale: Determines a canonical exact Euclidean diameter and every maximizer of a well-studied family in all dimensions, with a sparse, exactly enumerated diameter graph rather than only an extremal numerical value. The diameter endpoint fraction among circumradius contacts is 1/(n-1), a natural asymptotic metric rigidity phenomenon not implied by the known radial shells.
